scope: Real Chromium worker, actual emitted file pins, normal official-download API, cold document reload with network disabled, five representative recordings across all four adapters and practice. The fixture shell selects fixed real sources; it does not mount an ordinary game or claim an entire installed distribution.
limitations: Full catalog offline dependency ownership is established by the linked emitted audit, not by these five browser performances.
This is an explicit small installation with the production worker template and a finite subset of the real core/download inventory; it is not the complete generated worker configuration.
Ordinary saved-game recovery and full navigation entry pages are outside this representative adapter/shell fixture.
All product bodies come from the audited exact emitted capture or an unchanged source file with its emitted pin; no local route, metadata, version or HTML projection is regenerated.
The constructed subset worker is served under a distinct fixture URL; the original emitted worker and original HTML are retained and separately hashed, not replaced by this fixture.
